title: Outlook: Share Word, Excel, and PowerPoint local files via the new Outlook for Windows
description: When working in an open Word, Excel, or PowerPoint file, users will now be able to send a copy of the locally stored file by email through the new Outlook for Windows.  #newoutlookforwindows
